device.description: 8-bit voltage-output DAC with internal programmable reference, TMS320/SPI serial interface (FS frame sync), programmable settling time and power down

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC latch; power-on reset clears the internal latches to all zero

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: SPD (D14) and PWR (D13) of the last word; REF1 REF0 from D1 D0 of a control-register word (00/11 external, 01 1.024 V, 10 2.048 V); power-on all zero

commands.name: Write DAC (R1 R0 = 00)
commands.note: D15 R1, D14 SPD, D13 PWR, D12 R0, then the DAC value MSB first

commands.name: Write control register (R1 R0 = 11)
commands.note: D1 D0 = REF1 REF0; D11-D2 don't care

protocol.note: FS falling starts the frame (CS must be low); DIN sampled MSB first on SCLK falling edges (SCLK high at FS falling, Figure 1 -> mode 2); after 16 bits the word moves to the DAC latch and the output updates

device.note: tlv5624.pdf (SLAS235B) p.1 (D/DGK pinout, description), p.2 (terminal functions), p.3 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 2.7-3.3 V and 4.5-5.5 V), p.6 (digital input timing, Figure 1), p.10 (power-on reset to zero, serial interface), p.12 (data format, register-select bits, control register REF1/REF0, reference bits), p.13 (example)

pages: (SLAS235B) p.1 (D/DGK pinout, description), p.2 (terminal functions), p.3 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 2.7-3.3 V and 4.5-5.5 V), p.6 (digital input timing, Figure 1), p.10 (power-on reset to zero, serial interface), p.12 (data format, register-select bits, control register REF1/REF0, reference bits), p.13 (example)
notModeled: analog: voltage output (x2 buffer), reference REF and the internal reference selected by REF1/REF0 (stored only); SPD (settling) and PWR (power down) affect the analog side only (stored in CTRL)
CS (enable, active low) is not modeled: the bus frame is FS (FS falling starts a word, as in the datasheet's three-wire connection with CS tied low); CS high does not block the model
a word cut short by FS rising before 16 bits (the datasheet moves the partial shift register to the DAC latch) is discarded
variants: tlv5624.pdf covers only the TLV5624 (C and I grades); TLV5636 is the 12-bit version (separate datasheet).
